title: [Awake] Show the expiration time in the regional format

proposed_comments.body:
**Severity:** `low`

Could you add focused unit coverage for the culture-sensitive output on this line? The linked issue specifically reports a 24-hour value being shown as `1:30` instead of `13:30`, and the new `M`/`t` format specifiers are intended to preserve both 24-hour output and AM/PM markers; a deterministic de-DE and en-US assertion would keep those cases from regressing. The validation describes a manual de-DE check and the existing suite passing, but the current PR adds no test for this formatting path.

confidence.rationale: The pinned upstream diff changes user-visible culture-sensitive formatting and the exact test tree has no expiration-format coverage; the PR's manual de-DE validation is useful counterevidence but does not provide regression protection.

actions.label: Post inline review comment
actions.note: One low-severity inline request for culture-specific regression tests.
